title: Heart Attack
immediate_warning: Call emergency services immediately if the person is unconscious or chest pain lasts more than 5 minutes.

immediate_warning_translations.en: Call emergency services immediately if the person is unconscious or chest pain lasts more than 5 minutes.
immediate_warning_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Call emergency services immediately if the person is unconscious or chest pain lasts more than 5 minutes.
immediate_warning_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Call emergency services immediately if the person is unconscious or chest pain lasts more than 5 minutes.
immediate_warning_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Call emergency services immediately if the person is unconscious or chest pain lasts more than 5 minutes.
immediate_warning_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Call emergency services immediately if the person is unconscious or chest pain lasts more than 5 minutes.

description: A heart attack occurs when blood flow to the heart is blocked.

description_translations.en: A heart attack occurs when blood flow to the heart is blocked.
description_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] A heart attack occurs when blood flow to the heart is blocked.
description_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] A heart attack occurs when blood flow to the heart is blocked.
description_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] A heart attack occurs when blood flow to the heart is blocked.
description_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] A heart attack occurs when blood flow to the heart is blocked.

steps.instruction: Call emergency services or take them to the nearest hospital immediately.

instruction_translations.en: Call emergency services or take them to the nearest hospital immediately.
instruction_translations.ha: Kira ayyukan gaggawa ko kai su asibiti mafi kusa nan da nan.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Call emergency services or take them to the nearest hospital immediately.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Call emergency services or take them to the nearest hospital immediately.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Call emergency services or take them to the nearest hospital immediately.

steps.instruction: Have the person sit down, rest, and try to keep calm.

instruction_translations.en: Have the person sit down, rest, and try to keep calm.
instruction_translations.ha: Sa mutumin ya zauna, ya huta, kuma ya yi ƙoƙarin kwantar da hankalinsa.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Have the person sit down, rest, and try to keep calm.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Have the person sit down, rest, and try to keep calm.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Have the person sit down, rest, and try to keep calm.

instruction_translations.ha: Sassauta duk wani sutura mai matse jiki.

steps.instruction: Ask if they take any chest pain medication, such as nitroglycerin, and help them take it.

instruction_translations.en: Ask if they take any chest pain medication, such as nitroglycerin, and help them take it.
instruction_translations.ha: Tambaya ko suna shan wani maganin ciwon ƙirji, kamar nitroglycerin, sannan a taimaka musu su sha.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Ask if they take any chest pain medication, such as nitroglycerin, and help them take it.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Ask if they take any chest pain medication, such as nitroglycerin, and help them take it.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Ask if they take any chest pain medication, such as nitroglycerin, and help them take it.

steps.instruction: If the person becomes unconscious and unresponsive, begin CPR.

instruction_translations.en: If the person becomes unconscious and unresponsive, begin CPR.
instruction_translations.ha: Idan mutumin ya suma kuma bai amsa ba, fara CPR.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the person becomes unconscious and unresponsive, begin CPR.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the person becomes unconscious and unresponsive, begin CPR.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the person becomes unconscious and unresponsive, begin CPR.

do_not: Do not leave the person alone.
Do not wait to see if the symptoms go away.
